Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills : Python (Programming Language)
Good to have skills : React.jsMinimum
3 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time educationSummarySeeking an experienced Python Full Stack Engineer with expertise in Python backend development, React.js-Angular front-end development, API integration, and enterprise application development. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.Experience 4+ years of Python Full Stack development experience Strong hands-on experience in React.js and/or AngularRoles & Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications. Build and integrate React.js-Angular front-end applications with Python back-end services. Develop reusable UI components and responsive web applications. Design secure authentication and authorization mechanisms. Build REST APIs and integrate front-end applications with backend systems. Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities. Mentor junior developers and contribute to architectural decisions.Must Have Skills:-Python Backend Python, OOPs, Design Patterns, Unit Testing FastAPI, Flask, Django REST Framework Authentication & Authorization (JWT-OAuth-SSO) SQL, PL-SQL, Data Modeling Shell Scripting Pandas, NumPy, DataFrames Performance Tuning & Code OptimizationFront-End Development (React.js & Angular) Develop responsive and reusable UI components using React.js and Angular Build Single Page Applications (SPA) using React Hooks, Context API, Redux, and Angular Framework Integrate React-Angular front-end with Python APIs (Flask, FastAPI, Django REST Framework) Consume RESTful APIs and handle asynchronous data fetching using Axios-Fetch Write Unit and Integration Tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Angular Testing Frameworks JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3DevOps & Tools Git, CI/CD Code Review & Deployment Best PracticesGood to Have:- Docker, Kubernetes AWS-Azure Cloud Microservices Architecture Basic AI-LLM Integration Exposure
Qualification 15 years full time education
